name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (battle/gfx domain). Name accurately describes the body: composites the battle tile map + all alive party-member sprites, drawing a spell-effect overlay sprite over chars in the hit list and the normal portrait over the rest. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Render the per-char layer of a spell-cast frame: chars in the target/hit list get the spell-effect sprite (spark/glow) drawn over them, every other alive char keeps its normal portrait.
logic_summary: 1) Composite the battle tile map into dst_buf+0x8088. 2) Resolve the effect sprite address from the portrait sheet: fx_sprite_addr = sheet + *(int32*)(sheet + 6 + fx_sprite_idx*4). 3) For each party slot (skip dead via flags bit0): window-cull against the battle view window (origin +/- max, +/-1 margins); compute char_screen_addr = dst_buf + 0x75D8 + (pos_y-origin_y)*0x2AC0 + (pos_x-origin_x)*0x18; scan the n_targets-byte target_array for char_idx (no early break -- scans whole list). Hit -> fd2_blit_sprite_with_decoded_pixels(char_screen_addr, fx_sprite_addr, 456). Miss -> normal portrait: frame = sprite_state[0]*0xC + (chapter_ambient_palette_anim_idx==3 ? 2 : idx); src = cache + *(int32*)(cache + frame*4); fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough(src, char_screen_addr, 456). Original tail-calls a shared epilogue (JMP 0x1317D); the C equivalent is the loop running to completion.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_composite_chars_with_spell_effect_overlay(uint32 dst_buf, uint32 n_targets, uint32 target_array, int fx_sprite_idx)

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Base address of the destination render buffer. Tile map is composited at dst_buf+0x8088 and char sprites land at dst_buf+0x75D8+row/col offsets. Caller passes the live large_game_state_buffer (variant A, fx 0x4A) and a malloc'd secondary buffer (variant B, fx 0x4B).
params.reason: Accurately names the destination buffer base; no address residue.

params.name: n_targets
params.semantics: Number of entries (bytes) in target_array; loop bound for the hit-list scan (signed compare).

params.name: target_array
params.semantics: Pointer to a byte array of char indices that are spell targets/hits; body reads *(uint8*)(target_array + scan_idx) and compares to char_idx.
params.reason: Accurately names the hit-list array pointer; no address residue.

params.name: fx_sprite_idx
params.semantics: Index into the portrait sheet directory selecting the spell-effect sprite (fx_sprite_addr = sheet + *(int32*)(sheet + 6 + fx_sprite_idx*4)). Caller passes 0x4A (variant A / white flash) or 0x4B (variant B / colour flash) to alternate the strobe.
params.reason: Accurately names the effect-sprite selector. 0x4A/0x4B are portrait-sheet sprite IDs (domain values), not address residue. Note: live Ghidra still labels this param 'workspace', a stale generic name; the src name fx_sprite_idx is correct and is the one to keep.

returns.semantics: No return value. Composites directly into dst_buf.
